shared_elements: a horizontal row of repeated small vertical strokes/signs
schematic linear outline drawing without infill
highly reduced human presence (standing/adoring figures vs. crew strokes)
justification: The only correspondence worth naming is that both surfaces contain a horizontal row of repeated small vertical marks (hieroglyphic signs in one, crew strokes above a hull in the other) and both use pure outline, uninfilled linear forms. Otherwise the depicted content is entirely different: A shows a framed scene of two facing human figures with an offering stand and registers of writing, while B shows two isolated schematic boats with upturned prows and scattered dots and no figures, framing or text.
